name: ChemBench
intro: ChemBench 是自动化化学知识与推理评测框架，包含 2,788 道人工或半自动整理的问题，并通过主题、技能和难度标签、模型适配提示、稳健答案解析及化学专家基线比较模型能力。
org: LAMA Lab and international chemistry collaborators
build_method: 人工与半自动问题整理, 双科学家复核, 自动结构检查, 化学语义标注
task_type: 科学问答, 化学推理
eval_feature: 知识、推理、计算与直觉, 主题和难度分层, 工具增强系统, 化学专家基线
scale: 2,788道题（2,544道选择题, 244道开放题）, Mini子集236题
build_method_en: Manual and Semi-programmatic Question Curation, Two-scientist Review, Automated Schema Checks, Chemical-semantic Annotation
eval_feature_en: Knowledge, Reasoning, Calculation, and Intuition; Topic and Difficulty Stratification; Tool-augmented Systems; Chemist Baseline
intro_en: ChemBench is an automated framework for evaluating chemical knowledge and reasoning. Its 2,788 manually or semi-programmatically curated questions are labeled by topic, skill, and difficulty and evaluated through model-aware prompting, robust parsing, and comparison with chemistry experts.

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against the peer-reviewed Nature Chemistry 17 (2025) article, Methods subsections Curation workflow, Model evaluation workflow, and Human baseline, plus arXiv:2404.01475v2 and official repository commit 45f8bad062fe552810c52be3a328d5da8597ed30. Official repository file locators: src/chembench/constant.py, src/chembench/extractor.py, and reports/confidence_estimates/run_confidence_estimates.py. The diagram is scoped to the paper-defined 2,788-item ChemBench (1,039 manual + 1,749 semi-programmatic; 2,544 multiple-choice + 244 open-ended), not later repository additions. It preserves the GitHub/BIG-bench schema and canary path, review by at least two scientists beyond the original curator plus automated checks, topic/skill/difficulty labels, exact 236-item Mini selection rules, separate answer and 1–5 confidence prompts, multi-stage answer parsing with LLM fallback, and the 19-expert all-Mini human baseline.
